findings.name: Insecure Telnet Management Service
findings.finding: No Telnet listener or access rules detected.

findings.name: SSH Management Access Restrictions
findings.finding: SSH is restricted to designated subnets and enforces SSH version 2.
findings.remediation: Audit authorized management subnet allocations periodically.

findings.name: HTTP/ASDM Management Exposure
findings.remediation: Maintain policy disabling unneeded web services.

findings.name: Security Event Logging & SIEM Integration
findings.finding: Logging is enabled, forwarded to remote syslog collectors, and configured with timestamps.
findings.remediation: Ensure NTP synchronization is maintained across all syslog collectors.

findings.name: SNMP Monitoring & Community Security
findings.finding: SNMP is configured using legacy v1/v2c community [REDACTED_COMMUNITY] without encrypted SNMPv3 users.
findings.remediation: Upgrade to SNMPv3 with SHA authentication and AES encryption (authPriv).

findings.name: Cryptographic Algorithms & TLS Protocols
findings.finding: No legacy DES, 3DES, RC4, MD5, or weak DH groups detected in crypto policies.

findings.name: AAA Framework & Centralized Identity
findings.finding: Centralized AAA authentication policy and server groups defined with fallback.
findings.remediation: Verify failover behavior when RADIUS/TACACS+ servers are unreachable.

findings.name: Overly Permissive ACL Rules
findings.finding:
Rules permitting traffic from 'any' source to targeted internal destinations:
57:access-list OUTSIDE_IN extended permit tcp any host 198.51.100.10 eq 443
findings.remediation: Audit rules to ensure source addresses are restricted to expected partner or internal subnets.

findings.name: Credential Storage & Password Encryption
findings.finding: No unencrypted 'enable password' or plaintext username passwords detected.
findings.remediation: Ensure 'password encryption aes' is active for local master keying.

findings.name: Session Timeouts & MPF Inspection Baseline
findings.nist_control: NIST SP 800-53: AC-11, AC-12, SI-4, SC-7
findings.finding: Explicit session timeouts configured; MPF inspection and security boundaries intact.
